description: What a secondhand item sells for on eBay US: a calibrated estimate with a range, the recent real sold comps behind it, three list prices (fast, market, patient) with the 14-day sell chance, the net after eBay fees, and a worth-it verdict when you pass what the user would pay. Give image_url (a public https link to a photo) whenever one exists; a description alone works but reads less.

condition.description: Condition as the user states it.

cost.description: What the user paid or would pay for it, for a worth-it verdict: in USD, or in the seller's own currency for a photo scan on a signed-in account.

description.description: What the item is: brand, model or pattern, size, any marks, completeness.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a photo of the item. Preferred over description alone.

title: Price an item
